rules.label: Cites the 2021 crypto notice (银发〔2021〕237号)
rules.verdict: Outdated unless the line also says it was repealed: the 2021 notice was repealed on 2026-02-06 by 银发〔2026〕42号.

rules.label: Uses a 0.42% conversion spread
rules.verdict: 0.42% is a full buy-to-sell spread. The one-way cost against the midpoint on the 2026-11-10 board is 0.2094%. Lines that present 0.42% as the cost of one conversion overstate it.

rules.label: Mentions staged emigrant remittance
rules.verdict: Mandatory staged remittance was abolished by 汇发〔2014〕2号. Lines stating it as a current requirement are wrong.

rules.label: Mentions SAFE head-office handling above CNY 500,000
rules.verdict: The head-office filing above CNY 500,000 was abolished by 汇发〔2014〕2号.

rules.label: Hard-codes a CNY/USD rate snapshot
rules.verdict: Dated observation. Archived editions use different readings (669.29, 669.03, 668.66 and others); this guide uses 668.51 sell / 665.71 buy from 2026-11-10 17:39:58. Figures from different snapshots must not be mixed.

rules.label: States FBAR penalty amounts of USD 16,536 / 165,353
rules.verdict: Matches 31 CFR 1010.821 for penalties assessed on or after 2025-01-17.

rules.label: States an older FBAR penalty amount
rules.verdict: Superseded inflation adjustment; current amounts are USD 16,536 and USD 165,353.

rules.label: Mentions a remittance tax
rules.ok_if: no remittance tax|not a remittance tax|from the United States|outbound|sent from|does not apply|physical
rules.verdict: The US 1% remittance transfer tax applies to cash-funded remittances sent from the United States, not to money arriving from China.

rules.label: States the CNY 20,000 cash limit
rules.verdict: This session saw the figure only in an excerpt of a government article; the PBOC announcement was not opened. Treat as unverified.

rules.label: Mentions USD 50,000
rules.verdict: USD 50,000 is (a) the annual quota for domestic individuals and Foreign Permanent Resident ID holders and (b) the single-payment threshold for the tax-filing form. It is not a cap on a passport-holding foreigner who has documents. Each line must be read in that light.

rules.label: Gives a percentage fee for Wise
rules.verdict: Wise publishes no fixed tariff for CNY; any percentage is a dated quote. Sampled quotes on 2026-11-10 are in this guide's cost ladder.

rules.label: Claims an all-in total
rules.verdict: An all-in total needs the FX margin, correspondent charges and the receiving-bank fee. Only the Bank of China route has all of them from official figures in this guide.
